description.narrative: This project aims at digitizing services at the Anti-Counterfeit Authority (ACA) in a bid to efficiently and effectively manage and eliminate the supply of counterfeit goods in the Kenyan market. The project entails the development of an online platform that will improve the efficiency of (among others); i) tracing and seizing of counterfeit goods;ii) Disseminate relevant information and create public awareness on counterfeiting in Kenya; andiii) Enhance coordination in the management if circulation of goods in the Kenyan market through improved information sharing among various government agencies involved in dealing with counterfeit goodsThe project scope covers software solutions, hardware and implementation of change management activities. Key components include;1.) Software solutions: Intelligent Quick Response Code System (QRC); IPR Recordal Code; Depot Enforcement and Case Management System; Counterfeit Goods Inventory Management System; Crowd-Based Counterfeit Reporting and Notification System; Integration2.) Purchase of hardware componentsChange Management and related activities
